title: WHOSOEVER WILL LET HIM RECEIVE

blocks.text: “The handwriting is on the wall, the nations are being weighed in God’s balances and they come up short concerning His word, glory and power!” – “We know there are many evil forces working in the world to destroy and deceive the people! Yet while all the unrest and confusion is going on, God will give us a great outpouring according to His word and prophecy!”

Joel 2:23, and it says: for he hath given you the former rain “moderately”, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month. – “The first rain in the land of Palestine comes in the Fall of the year when they plant their crops, and it causes the grain to spring up. The second rain comes in the Springtime when the harvest takes place! But as the text shows, God is here speaking of an outpouring of His Spirit, and He is using the two seasons of rain to show the new thing that He is going to do; that is, He is going to give two seasons of rain in one month; surely a most unusual thing, and something that has never occurred before!”

In many parts of the Bible the Lord spoke He would do a new thing in our generation! For instance Isa. 42:9, “Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them!” – “As we see right at the end of the age a torrential, short, powerful restoration will occur as God’s spiritual forces combine to unite His children in strong faith and miracles! – What a supernatural hour we are entering!”

“In this next Scripture it reveals that He is going to give us bright clouds of His glory! This is speaking more of a spiritual rain than of a natural rain!” – Zech. 10:1, “Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.” “Notice it says to every one that ask for it! – Also in Joel 2:28 we see a similar promise only in a deeper dimension.” “And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions.” Read Verse 29.

“This outpouring has been upon the Gentile elect, and now we see in this scripture it has fallen upon the Jewish elect, after the Gentile church is gone!” The fact it said all flesh reveals it went to Gentiles and Jews!

In chapter 1, Ezekiel saw in verse 4, “a move of God’s great revival power in clouds of fire, and then it manifested like a rainbow in the day of rain!” Vs. 28 – “This was accompanied by spinning lights in wheel form, giving forth beautiful demonstrations of the glory of God! Vs. 13-14, These were angels in celestial chariots of some sort! It says they ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning!” – “The Scriptures also say there are ‘chariots’ of salvation!” (Hab. 3:8) – “So even in our day some of the lights that are seen in the heavens is predicting to us the salvation and miraculous restoration that we are in and entering more!” – “It also reveals the great crisis that is coming upon the world as the age ends!”

“We have come full cycle! The germ was planted in the first church age, Ephesus. Now in the latter church age it is fully developed and will separate from the Laodicean age, the church that was spewed out of God’s mouth!” (Rev. 3:16) Verse 10, “reveals the real true church God keeps!” – This message is for spiritual ears. In each age Jesus closed with a command, “He who hath an ear, let him hear what the spirit saith unto the churches!” Verse 22 – Also in Hosea 6:3, “And he shall come unto us as the rain, as the ‘latter and former’ rain unto the earth!” – “Now watch this in Verse 1 it reveals the first coming of Jesus to heal them! Verse 2, reveals after 2 days (2 thousand years after Jesus’ first coming) He will revive us! (The great outpouring coming off of our revival.) Then it says in the third day we shall live in His sight!” (meaning Millennium) – “Jesus is almost ready to return to the Jew! (Rev. chap. 7) – Our time is very short!” – Haggai 2:6-9 reveals, “during our age of prophecy and wonders the Lord would shake the heavens, earth and sea.” We are witnessing this almost daily! At the same time, “He would shake all nations.” We are seeing this! – “And at this time the glory would come unto the house of the Lord!” Verse 8 reveals “it was at a time that they were gathering up the silver and the gold! But the Lord declared that it was His any way!” – Verse 9, “The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts!”

“The latter restoration will be more powerful than the first! James 5:3 confirms the insight. And Verse 7 confirms the early and latter rain! Verse 8 revealed the Lord’s coming draweth nigh!” – “Behold, saith the Lord, fear not O people; be glad and rejoice for the Lord will revive you completely and do great things!” Hab. 2:3 reveals “all of it is for an appointed time! And at the end of our age, which is now, it would speak and not lie! Though at first it looked like it would tarry, we were told to wait for it, because it will surely come, then all of a sudden the tarrying would be over with; and we would be in the midst of it like we are now! – The vision is fulfilling upon us!” This matches Matt. 25:5-10. – Verse 5 reveals “a tarrying time too! But all of a sudden there is a midnight cry and the bridegroom came! Verse 10 portrays those that were ready went with Him! – So we see after a lull, (and we have been in one) there will be a quick, short, powerful move and we will be gone!”

“There are many more Scriptures concerning this, but we will print one more as the Lord gives us the final call!” – Rev. 22:16, “Jesus said personally He has sent His angel to tell us of these things! – He said he was the creator and the Messiah (root and offspring). He revealed Himself as the pillar of fire (the bright and morning star!)” We are entering this Scripture now! Verse 17, “And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely!”

“This shows us that the call is open to whosoever will, let him receive!” – “Behold, do ye remember that I said O ye people sing a new song, For the former things have come to pass, and new things I do declare!” – “Behold, be ye also ready!” – “Although there will be tremendous forces against this restorative move, we will be victorious singing and rejoicing with Him!”
